## Checklist
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] New rule or codemod change: added a fixture and a test (broken → fixed, and idempotent on a second run)
- [ ] False positive or negative fix: added a regression test with a minimal repro
- [ ] No proprietary fonts added (bundled fonts must be OFL, with their license text)
- [ ] Added a CHANGELOG entry (and a "Decisions" note if you made a design choice)
